title: Self-Oscillating Photonic Frequency Comb for Sub-THz Local Oscillator Generation in Earth Observation Systems
abstract: Earth observation missions rely on microwave and sub-terahertz radiometry for retrieving atmospheric parameters such as temperature, humidity, and cloud properties, with the 183- and 229-GHz spectral regions being particularly relevant. Local-oscillator (LO) generation at these frequencies requires low phase noise and high frequency stability while meeting stringent size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints. Conventional architectures employ dielectric resonator oscillators followed by cascaded frequency-multiplication stages, requiring dedicated generation chains for different frequency bands and increasing hardware complexity. Furthermore, frequency multiplication degrades the phase noise of the generated signal. This work proposes and numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic architecture for LO generation in Earth observation receivers. Cascaded Mach-Zehnder and phase modulation within an optoelectronic feedback loop generate an optical frequency comb with enhanced higher-order components. A combination of optical filters is used to select the required comb line. First, a conventional bandpass filter with a bandwidth of approximately 10 GHz isolates the spectral region containing the desired component, after which a narrowband dual cavity Bragg grating ring resonator (BGRR) with a bandwidth of approximately 3 MHz provides the final line selection. The selected comb line is then combined with an optical reference derived from the same laser and photodetected to generate the desired millimeter-wave or sub-terahertz signal through optical heterodyning. Numerical simulations are presented for 183- and 229-GHz generation, demonstrating the ability of the same underlying architecture to address multiple LO frequencies by tuning the OEO electrical filter to the appropriate oscillation frequency and selecting the corresponding comb order.

summaries.en: This work proposes and numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic architecture that uses cascaded Mach-Zehnder and phase modulation in an optoelectronic feedback loop to generate an optical frequency comb, with optical filtering to select a comb line that is heterodyned against a laser reference to produce low-phase-noise 183- and 229-GHz local-oscillator signals for Earth observation radiometry.
summaries.zh: 本工作提出并通过数值仿真研究了一种可重构的自振荡微波光子架构，该架构在光电反馈环路中采用级联马赫-曾德尔调制与相位调制生成光频梳，并通过光滤波选择梳线，与同一激光器的光参考进行外差拍频，从而为地球观测辐射测量产生低相位噪声的183 GHz和229 GHz本振信号。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、光電子帰還ループ内で縦続接続したマッハ・ツェンダー変調と位相変調により光周波数コムを生成し、光フィルタで選択したコム線を同一レーザー由来の光参照とヘテロダイン検波することで、地球観測用放射計向けの低位相雑音な183 GHzおよび229 GHz局部発振信号を発生させる、再構成可能な自励発振マイクロ波フォトニクス構成を提案し数値的に検討した。

title: A hybrid wave-mode formulation for the vibro-acoustic analysis of 2D periodic structures
abstract: In the framework of vibrational analysis of 2D periodic waveguides, Floquet-Bloch theorem is widely applied for the determination of wave dispersion characteristics. In this context, the Wave Finite Element Method (WFEM) combines Periodic Structure Theory (PST) with standard FE packages, enabling wave dispersion analysis of waveguides involving structurally realistic unit-cells. For such applications, the computational efficiency of the WFEM, depends on the choice of the formulation and can lead to numerical issues, worsened by extensive computational cost. This paper presents a coupled wave-mode approach for the determination of wave dispersion characteristics in structurally advanced periodic structures. It combines two scales of model order reduction. At the unit-cell's scale, Component Mode Synthesis (CMS) provides the displacement field associated with local resonances of the periodic structure, while the free wave propagation is considered using a spectral problem projection on a reduced set of shape functions associated with propagating waves, thus providing considerable reduction of the computational cost. An application is provided for a bi-directionally stiffened panel and the influence of reduction parameters is discussed, as well as the robustness of the numerical results.

summaries.en: This paper presents a coupled wave-mode approach that combines Component Mode Synthesis at the unit-cell scale with spectral problem projection onto a reduced set of propagating-wave shape functions to efficiently determine wave dispersion characteristics in structurally advanced 2D periodic waveguides within the Wave Finite Element Method framework.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种耦合波-模态方法，将单元胞尺度的组件模态综合与基于传播波形状函数缩减集的谱问题投影相结合，从而在波有限元方法框架下高效确定结构复杂的二维周期波导的波色散特性。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ユニットセルスケールでのコンポーネントモード合成と伝播波形状関数の縮小集合へのスペクトル問題の射影を組み合わせた波動-モード連成手法を提案し、波動有限要素法の枠組みにおいて構造的に高度な2次元周期導波路の波分散特性を効率的に決定する。

title: Parameter-efficient neural computing with programmable photonic meshes
abstract: Memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming major constraints in neural-network computing, motivating parameter-efficient representations that reduce model storage and data movement. Tensor-network methods already enable substantial compression of neural networks, but their structured operations are often poorly matched to conventional processors optimized for dense linear algebra. Such representations can be implemented in photonic hardware, although this typically requires optical architectures tailored to a particular factorization. Here we propose a different approach based on programmable photonic meshes. Compact electronic parameters determine the interferometer phases, while optical interference produces a dense, generally high-rank transformation. Since the parameterization remains electronic, its dimensionality and structure can be changed without modifying the optical circuit. Numerical experiments in end-to-end training demonstrate that the proposed photonic layers match or outperform strongly compressed tensor-train and brickwork layers, often with fewer trainable parameters. Experiments in parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a language model also show advantages over established digital adapters. The reduced trainable state lowers persistent memory requirements and offers the potential to reduce data movement and bandwidth demands.

summaries.en: Programmable photonic meshes use compact electronic parameters to set interferometer phases so that optical interference produces dense high-rank transformations, matching or outperforming compressed tensor-train and brickwork layers and digital adapters in parameter-efficient neural computing and fine-tuning.
summaries.zh: 可编程光子网格利用紧凑的电子参数设定干涉仪相位，通过光学干涉产生稠密的高秩变换，在参数高效的神经网络计算与微调中达到或超过压缩的张量列层、砖块层以及数字适配器的表现。
summaries.ja: プログラマブルなフォトニックメッシュは、コンパクトな電子パラメータで干渉計の位相を決定し、光干渉によって稠密で一般に高ランクな変換を生成することで、パラメータ効率の高いニューラル計算とファインチューニングにおいて、圧縮されたテンソルトレイン層やブリックワーク層、デジタルアダプタと同等以上の性能を示す。

title: Observation and control of polariton noise in a thermal Rydberg atom electrometer
abstract: The establishment of metrics and control of fundamental noise sources in quantum sensing is a long-standing goal in quantum science and technology. We report on the observation of polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg atom vapor and demonstrate its active control and suppression using a radio-frequency field in Rydberg electrometry. The noise exhibits structured amplification and reduction across the Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency resonance. This reveals a nonlinear slow-light feedback mechanism in which the polariton medium stores and releases probe-field energy. We show that the reference radio-frequency field used in Rydberg heterodyne receivers can also tune the medium into an operating regime where high electromagnetic-field responsivity coincides with reduced optical noise. This operating-point control enables optimization of the electric-field sensitivity within the constraints imposed by Rydberg-polariton physics. These results establish polariton noise as a previously unrecognized intrinsic noise source in thermal Rydberg vapors and the corresponding control method as a crucial aspect of continued efforts to achieve fundamental sensitivity limits in Rydberg electrometry.
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: This paper reports the observation of polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg atom vapor and demonstrates its suppression via a radio-frequency field in Rydberg electrometry, identifying polariton noise as an intrinsic noise source and showing that the heterodyne reference field can tune the medium to a regime of high field responsivity with reduced optical noise.
summaries.zh: 本文报道了在热里德堡原子蒸气中观察到极化激元介导的光学噪声，并展示了利用射频场在里德堡电场测量中对其实现主动控制与抑制，从而将极化激元噪声确认为一种内禀噪声源，并表明外差参考场可将介质调谐至兼具高电场响应度与低光学噪声的工作区间。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、熱リドベリ原子蒸気におけるポラリトン媒介の光学ノイズの観測を報告し、リドベリ電場測定において無線周波数場を用いたその能動的な制御と抑制を示すことで、ポラリトンノイズを内在的ノイズ源として同定するとともに、ヘテロダイン参照場が高電場応答度と低光学ノイズを両立する動作領域へ媒質を調整できることを明らかにした。

title: Three-dimensional stochastic retinal models for synthetic eye-models
abstract: Purpose: Current eye models often assume a fixed spherical retinal curvature of 12 mm, which does not reflect the anatomical variability observed in vivo. This study proposes an extension incorporating the stochastic relationship between axial length and three-dimensional (3D) retinal curvature, enabling more realistic 3D eye models. Methods: Axial length and 3D retinal curvature data from 94 subjects, split into five subsets for cross-validation, were used to construct two probabilistic models: a Single Gaussian Model (SGM) and two-component Multi Gaussian Mixture Model (MGMM). Both were converted into conditional forms to estimate retinal curvature for a specific axial length, and evaluated against measured data distributions. Results: All models produced radii of curvature comparable to measured data (median difference <0.2 mm). Non-conditionally, the MGMM described the distribution slightly better than SGM, with higher density overlap (>94% vs. >86%), but similar variance (worst f-test (p-value) 1.05 (0.71) vs. 1.05 (0.73)). Conditioned on axial length, both models performed similarly with overlap exceeding 93% and the worst f-test 1.02 (0.84). Given its simplicity and robustness, the conditional SGM was selected, achieving similar validation results: median difference (<0.10 mm), overlap (>92%), and a non-significant worst f-test (1.02 (0.85)). Conclusions: The conditional SGM enables accurate generation of anatomically realistic 3D retinal curvatures based on axial length, supporting improved stochastic eye modeling for visual optics and population-based simulations of healthy eyes. Translational relevance: Replacing the fixed 12 mm retina assumption with a population-based stochastic model improves anatomical accuracy of eye models used in optical design and treatment planning.

summaries.en: A conditional single Gaussian model accurately generates anatomically realistic three-dimensional retinal curvatures from axial length, replacing the fixed 12 mm spherical retinal assumption in stochastic eye models for visual optics and population-based simulations.

title: Single-Mode Laser Arrays with Size-Invariant Loss Discrimination
abstract: In conventional coupled oscillator lattices and laser arrays, expanding the active volume inevitably causes spectral crowding and degrades spatial uniformity, posing a long-standing barrier to high-power single-mode operation. We uncover a dissipative selection mechanism in sparse star networks that decouples modal selectivity from lattice size constraints. By engineering dissipative auxiliary couplings between a central hub and N peripheral resonators, the system establishes an exact star-Laplacian symmetry. This enforces a target eigenstate that is immune to all lossy channels while maintaining equal amplitude across all main nodes. All competing eigenstates break this symmetry, driving the auxiliary loss and opening a persistent, size-independent modal loss gap that prevents multi-mode competition. Realistic microring simulations validate the robustness of this dark-state isolation under electromagnetic dispersion and mechanism extension to arbitrary arrays is allowed when meets the system's exceptional point. By exploiting graph topology to bypass multi-mode competition, this work establishes a general route toward scalable high-power single-supermode laser arrays and robust state selection in coupled non-Hermitian systems.

summaries.en: A dissipative selection mechanism in sparse star networks using engineered auxiliary couplings creates a size-independent modal loss gap that isolates a single dark eigenstate, enabling scalable high-power single-mode laser arrays validated by microring simulations.
summaries.zh: 稀疏星形网络中通过设计耗散辅助耦合建立的模态损耗间隙与阵列尺寸无关，可隔离单一暗本征态，经微环仿真验证，为实现可扩展的高功率单模激光阵列提供了通用途径。
summaries.ja: 疎なスター型ネットワークにおいて散逸的補助結合を設計することで、サイズに依存しないモード損失ギャップが生じて単一の暗状態固有モードが選択され、マイクロリングシミュレーションで検証されたようにスケーラブルな高出力単一モードレーザアレイへの一般的な道筋を確立する。

title: Sensitivity and Identifiability of Tumor-Related Changes in Longitudinal Microwave Breast Imaging
abstract: Microwave imaging could monitor breast tumor response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, but between-visit changes in breast positioning and normal tissue may confound tumor-related changes. We use eight patient-specific dielectric models from longitudinal MRI of two patients at four time points. For each model, 24-port S-parameters were simulated from 1 to 3 GHz, and Jacobians computed for tumor permittivity and loss, fibroglandular tissue (FGT) permittivity, and breast rotation and translation. 1 mm positioning changes produced changes 20 to 50 times larger than a 10% tumor permittivity change above 2 GHz. Nevertheless, tumor sensitivity patterns were weakly aligned with positioning patterns, tumor-FGT similarity exceeded 0.8 at only some visits, and the Jacobians remained well conditioned. Tumor responses are thus small but separable; monitoring will require positioning correction, frequency selection, and noise-aware detectability analysis.

summaries.en: Using patient-specific dielectric models, this study shows that although 1 mm positioning changes produce S-parameter changes 20–50 times larger than a 10% tumor permittivity change above 2 GHz, tumor sensitivity patterns are only weakly aligned with positioning patterns and the Jacobians remain well conditioned, indicating that tumor-related changes are small but separable if positioning correction, frequency selection, and noise-aware detectability analysis are applied.
summaries.zh: 该研究利用患者特异性介电模型表明，尽管在2 GHz以上1 mm的位置变化所产生的S参数变化比10%的肿瘤介电常数变化大20至50倍，但肿瘤敏感度模式与位置变化模式仅弱对齐且雅可比矩阵保持良态，说明肿瘤相关变化虽小但可分离，前提是进行位置校正、频率选择和噪声感知的可检测性分析。
summaries.ja: 患者固有の誘電体モデルを用いた本研究は、2 GHz以上では1 mmの位置変化が10%の腫瘍誘電率変化より20〜50倍大きいSパラメータ変化を生じるものの、腫瘍感度パターンと位置変化パターンの整合は弱くヤコビアンは良条件のままであることを示し、位置補正・周波数選択・雑音を考慮した検出性解析を行えば腫瘍関連変化は小さいながら分離可能であることを明らかにした。

title: Terabit-scale wavelength-multiplexed transmitter enabled by thin-film lithium tantalate
abstract: Artificial-intelligence systems face a growing data-movement bottleneck and require higher interconnect bandwidth without a proportional increase in electrical power consumption or the number of laser sources and fibre connections. Moving optical interfaces closer to computing chips reduces electrical transmission loss, while demanding optical engines that combine high channel capacity, broadband modulation and simple packaging. Although wavelength multiplexing relieves pressure on the fibre budget, integrating shared multi-wavelength sources with dense wavelength routing and broadband modulation in a compact format remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a monolithic transmitter that brings these functions together on a single material platform, enabled by the low birefringence and native Pockels response of thin-film lithium tantalate. The device separates, independently modulates and recombines eight wavelength channels between one optical input and output. This architecture retains a two-fibre interface as the channel count grows, directly addressing the packaging burden of parallel optical links. Measurements across the eight channels establish an aggregate line rate of 1.6 Tbit s$^{-1}$. Operation with a shared optical frequency comb achieves an estimated net data rate of 0.58 Tbit s$^{-1}$ across four channels, demonstrating compatibility with a common multi-wavelength source. Scaling this architecture into multiple wavelength-multiplexed engines offers a path towards 10 Tbit s$^{-1}$ optical interfaces with high bandwidth per unit package edge, positioning thin-film lithium tantalate for the next generation of co-packaged optical interconnects.

summaries.en: Researchers demonstrated a monolithic thin-film lithium tantalate transmitter that separates, independently modulates and recombines eight wavelength channels between a single optical input and output, achieving an aggregate line rate of 1.
summaries.zh: 研究人员展示了一种基于薄膜钽酸锂的单片发射器，可在单一光输入与输出之间分离、独立调制并重新合并八个波长通道，实现1.
summaries.ja: 研究チームは、薄膜タンタル酸リチウムを用いたモノリシック送信器を実証し、単一の光入力と出力の間で8つの波長チャネルを分離・独立変調・再結合して1.

title: NIR-probe transient absorption on rubrene microcavities demonstrates no changes to singlet fission by strong coupling
abstract: Strong light-matter coupling has been proposed to control singlet-exciton fission, yet reported effects remain controversial due to the prevalence of cavity-induced optical artifacts in transient absorption measurements. Here, we investigate singlet fission in dielectric microcavities containing rubrene by probing in the near-infrared region, outside the cavity stopband, to eliminate mode-filtering artifacts. Across contrasting cavity quality factors ($Q = 90$ and $1150$) and a range of exciton-photon detunings ($+20$ to $-110$ meV), we find that the underlying kinetics are virtually identical to uncoupled films. Although minor spectral changes occur, transfer matrix simulations reveal these stem purely from mirror interference rather than modified photophysics. Transient electron paramagnetic resonance further confirms that high-spin triplet dynamics remain unperturbed. Together, these findings establish a widely applicable experimental framework for evaluating molecular photophysics in microcavities, revealing that singlet fission remains unaltered in strongly coupled rubrene.

summaries.en: Using near-infrared transient absorption outside the cavity stopband to avoid optical artifacts, this study finds that strong light-matter coupling in rubrene microcavities leaves singlet fission kinetics and triplet dynamics essentially unchanged relative to uncoupled films.
summaries.zh: 该研究在腔停带之外的近红外区进行瞬态吸收测量以规避光学伪影，发现红荧烯微腔中的强光-物质耦合并未改变单线态裂分的动力学和三线态动力学，其结果与未耦合薄膜基本一致。
summaries.ja: 本研究はキャビティ阻止帯域外の近赤外過渡吸収測定により光学アーティファクトを排除し、ルブレン微細共振器中の強結合が一重項分裂の動力学や三重項動力学を未結合膜とほぼ変えないことを示した。

title: Vacuum-Field Squeezing by Molecules in Optical Cavities: An Exact Bound and Linear-Response Theory
abstract: The ground state of a molecule coupled to an optical cavity contains virtual photons, and squeezing of the photonic field has been found in exactly solvable models, perturbation theory, and numerical calculations. Here, two exact sum rules for the field quadratures show that, within the dipole approximation, the vector-potential fluctuations of a linearly polarized mode never exceed their vacuum value in the ground state of any molecule at any coupling strength. Consequently, the field is squeezed whenever the mode couples to a dipole-allowed transition from a nondegenerate ground state, and the cavity-induced ground-state energy shift cannot increase with the cavity frequency at a fixed coupling vector, which is an exact constraint on approximate methods. Moreover, the incoherent photon statistics, which exclude the coherent part of the field, are never sub-Poissonian. At weak coupling, an exact resolvent expression reduces the squeezing and the ratio of the anomalous to the normal photon moment to linear-response properties of the isolated molecule, with the ratio set by a mean excitation energy. Time-dependent density functional theory with CAM-B3LYP and PBE0 reproduces exact and QED coupled-cluster references for both quantities to within 5% at 45 benchmark points. A survey of 29 molecules gives mean excitation energies of 9.5-21 eV at a cavity frequency of 2 eV and shows that the most polarizable molecules squeeze the field the most.

summaries.en: Exact sum rules show that within the dipole approximation the vector-potential fluctuations of a linearly polarized cavity mode never exceed their vacuum value in any molecule's ground state at any coupling strength, with squeezing occurring whenever the mode couples to a dipole-allowed transition from a nondegenerate ground state, and weak-coupling linear-response theory reproduces exact and QED coupled-cluster references to within 5%.
summaries.zh: 精确求和规则表明，在偶极近似下，线偏振腔模的矢量势涨落在任何分子基态、任何耦合强度下都不超过其真空值，只要该模式与非简并基态的一个偶极允许跃迁耦合就会产生压缩，且弱耦合线性响应理论在45个基准点上的结果与精确及QED耦合簇参考值吻合在5%以内。
summaries.ja: 厳密な総和規則により、双極子近似の下では線形偏光したキャビティモードのベクトルポテンシャル揺らぎは任意の分子の基底状態でいかなる結合強度でも真空値を超えず、非縮退基底状態からの双極子許容遷移と結合する場合にスクイージングが生じ、弱結合線形応答理論は45のベンチマーク点で厳密解およびQED結合クラスター参照値を5%以内で再現する。

title: Optical imaging in dual-phase xenon time projection chambers for neutrinoless double beta decay searches
abstract:
Dual-phase xenon time projection chambers (TPCs) are the leading technology for WIMP dark matter searches and have also demonstrated competitive sensitivities to neutrinoless double beta decays (0$
u eta eta$) of \ce{^{136}Xe}. However, the large energy disparity between these two signals requires different detector optimizations. In particular, 0$
u eta eta$\ searches in liquid xenon desire efficient rejection of closely located multiscatters of background gamma rays near the 0$
u eta eta$\ energy, a capability achieved only in the vertical dimension in existing dual-phase xenon TPCs. We propose a highly customized, wide-angle optical system that can be conveniently integrated into large xenon TPCs and provide mm-scale transverse position resolution for MeV signals by imaging gas electroluminescence light. This approach preserves a TPC's low-energy sensitivity and optimizes a single experiment for both dark matter and 0$
u eta eta$\ searches. This paper discusses the design, simulated performance, and implications of the imaging system for future liquid xenon-based 0$
u eta eta$\ searches.
subjects: Instrumentation and Detectors (physics.ins-det) ; High Energy Physics - Experiment (hep-ex)

summaries.en: A wide-angle optical imaging system integrated into dual-phase xenon TPCs can provide mm-scale transverse position resolution for MeV signals by imaging gas electroluminescence light, enabling efficient rejection of gamma-ray multiscatters near the 0νββ energy while preserving low-energy dark matter sensitivity.
summaries.zh: 集成于双相氙时间投影室中的广角光学成像系统通过对气体电致发光进行成像，可为MeV信号提供毫米级横向位置分辨率，从而有效排除接近0νββ能量的伽马射线多重散射，同时保持低能暗物质探测灵敏度。
summaries.ja: 二相キセノンTPCに統合された広角光学イメージングシステムは、ガス中の電界発光を撮像することでMeV信号に対してmmスケールの横方向位置分解能を提供し、低エネルギー暗黒物質感度を保ちつつ0νββエネルギー付近のガンマ線多重散乱を効率的に排除できる。

title: Trajectree - A quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator
abstract: We introduce Trajectree, a quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator that uses a novel, state-saving partial execution of the quantum circuits to simulate broad and deep noisy quantum circuits efficiently. Trajectree can efficiently generate a large number of Monte Carlo samples by saving partially executed trajectories. We conduct extensive performance analysis of the Trajectree approach, proving the utility of the trajectory saving scheme for simulations of open quantum systems. Using this architecture, we show that Trajectree can simulate standard benchmark noisy circuits over five times faster than Google's QSim, a part of the Cirq package. We also analyze Trajectree's performance for simulating quantum optical systems relevant to communication and computing applications. We demonstrate applications of the optical backend to simulate three optical experiments: CHSH Bell test, entanglement swapping, and optical CNOT gate. This shows Trajectree's potential for simulating noisy qudit and optical systems efficiently.

summaries.en: Trajectree is a quantum trajectory-based circuit simulator that saves partially executed trajectories to efficiently generate many Monte Carlo samples for broad and deep noisy quantum circuits, simulating standard benchmark circuits over five times faster than Google's QSim and also supporting optical experiments such as the CHSH Bell test, entanglement swapping, and an optical CNOT gate.
summaries.zh: Trajectree 是一种基于量子轨迹的量子线路模拟器，通过保存部分执行的轨迹来高效生成大量蒙特卡洛样本，从而模拟宽而深的含噪量子线路，在标准基准含噪线路上的模拟速度超过谷歌 QSim 五倍以上，并可用于模拟 CHSH 贝尔测试、纠缠交换和光学 CNOT 门等光学实验。
summaries.ja: Trajectreeは部分的に実行した軌道を保存することで広く深いノイズを含む量子回路の多数のモンテカルロサンプルを効率的に生成する量子軌道ベースの量子回路シミュレータであり、標準ベンチマークのノイズ回路をGoogleのQSimより5倍以上高速にシミュレートできるほか、CHSHベルテスト、エンタングルメントスワッピング、光学CNOTゲートなどの光学実験のシミュレーションにも適用できる。

title: Adiabatic controlled-$Z$ gate for neutral atoms with Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing
abstract: We study an adiabatic controlled-$Z$ (CZ) gate for neutral atoms in which dipole-dipole coupling between nearly degenerate Rydberg pair states enhances the interaction between dressed ground states. This coupling produces an avoided crossing in the two-atom dressed-state spectrum. Approaching the crossing enhances the dressed interaction, but also reduces the dressed-state gap and increases the Rydberg admixture. We identify a Förster-enhanced operating range in which the required conditional phase is accumulated with adiabatic return and small transient Rydberg population. We then analyze the finite-time dynamics of the two-qubit computational states under a smooth pulse. Reducing the dressing strength weakens the dressed interaction, so maintaining the target phase at the same pulse duration requires operation closer to the avoided crossing, where the Rydberg admixture increases. This dependence is then used to select the shortest gate at a fixed peak Rabi frequency in the Förster-enhanced operating range that accumulates the CZ phase with high Bell-state fidelity while keeping the Rydberg population small. Changing the Förster defect shifts the avoided crossing, while the gate parameters change only weakly. For a specific rubidium Förster channel, the selected gate corresponds to experimentally relevant laser coupling, pulse duration, and interatomic separation. We also estimate errors from the finite Rydberg lifetime and from weak excitation of a neighboring spectator atom. For the parameters considered, the spectator-induced error remains below the finite-lifetime contribution.

summaries.en: This paper analyzes an adiabatic controlled-Z gate for neutral atoms in which Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing of nearly degenerate pair states creates an avoided crossing that allows accumulation of the conditional phase with small transient Rydberg population, enabling selection of short high-fidelity gates for realistic rubidium parameters.
summaries.zh: 本文分析了中性原子中的绝热受控-Z门，其中近简并里德堡对态的Förster增强缀饰产生避免交叉，使得在较小的瞬态里德堡布居下积累条件相位，从而为实际铷参数选择短时高保真度的门。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、準縮退したリュードベリ対状態のFörster増強ドレッシングにより回避交差が生じ、過渡的なリュードベリ占有を小さく保ちつつ条件位相を蓄積できる中性原子の断熱制御-Zゲートを解析し、現実的なルビジウムパラメータに対する短時間・高忠実度ゲートの選択を可能にする。

title: Chiral Floquet Selection of an Algebraic Rydberg Bound State in the Continuum
abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) remain localized despite the presence of extended modes at the same energy. In driven systems with long-range couplings, the absence of radiation does not by itself determine how a bound state decays in space. We study a Hermitian Rydberg spin waveguide coupled to a four-site plaquette, where a winding drive phase combines rotation with time translation to forbid propagating guide channels in one symmetry sector. The resulting eigenstate remains embedded in the continuum of other sectors and carries an inverse-cube waveguide amplitude, with coherent contributions from direct plaquette--guide coupling and long-range guide propagation. Pair-state calculations determine the microscopic couplings in the axial geometry, while coherent Floquet mixing sets the weight of the dominant circulating plaquette mode. The bound state thus retains the spatial signature of the long-range coupling even when radiation is forbidden.

summaries.en: A Hermitian Rydberg spin waveguide coupled to a four-site plaquette with a winding Floquet drive phase supports an algebraic bound state in the continuum whose inverse-cube waveguide amplitude reflects long-range coherent coupling even though radiation is symmetry-forbidden in one sector.
summaries.zh: 一个与四格点plaquette耦合的厄米里德堡自旋波导，在引入绕转Floquet驱动相位后，支持一种代数型连续谱束缚态，其波导振幅按反立方衰减，反映出长程相干耦合即使在某个对称扇区中辐射被禁戒时依然保留。
summaries.ja: 巻き付きFloquet駆動位相を持つ四サイトプラケット結合エルミート型リュードベリ・スピン導波路において、一つの対称性セクターで放射が禁じられていても長距離コヒーレント結合を反映する逆三乗導波路振幅を持つ代数的連続スペクトル束縛状態が実現する。

title: \textit{In situ} certification of multiparticle indistinguishability in a generic interferometer
abstract: We propose a scalable and efficient \textit{in situ} method for assessing the multiparticle indistinguishability of identical bosons or fermions in quantum interference experiments on linear interferometers by harnessing quantum parallelism and the bunching/anti-bunching tendencies of these particles. The proposed certification method can be applied to any generic linear interferometer. For particles occupying distinct input ports of a Haar-random unitary interferometer, the number of experimental runs required to attain a prescribed statistical precision is polynomial in the number of particles, the interferometer size, and the inverse precision, with high probability. Our method is robust under losses: for uniform particle losses, the polynomial scaling is preserved when the inverse single-particle survival probability is polynomially bounded. Our scheme is especially suitable for certifying the indistinguishability of single photons in large-scale interference experiments, such as Boson Sampling in the regime of quantum advantage over classical computation.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a scalable in situ method that certifies the multiparticle indistinguishability of identical bosons or fermions in any generic linear interferometer by exploiting quantum parallelism and bunching/anti-bunching tendencies, with a polynomial number of experimental runs, robustness to uniform particle losses under polynomial inverse survival probability, and particular suitability for certifying photon indistinguishability in large-scale Boson Sampling experiments.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的原位方法，利用量子并行性以及相同玻色子或费米子的聚束/反聚束特性，在任意通用线性干涉仪中验证多粒子不可区分性；该方法所需的实验次数为多项式规模，在均匀粒子损耗且单粒子存活概率倒数多项式有界时仍保持多项式标度，特别适用于大规模玻色采样实验中光子不可区分性的验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、量子並列性と同種ボソンまたはフェルミオンのバンチング・アンチバンチング傾向を利用して、任意の汎用線形干渉計における多粒子不可識別性を検証するスケーラブルなin situ手法を提案し、実験回数が多項式規模で済み、一様な粒子損失に対して単一粒子生存確率の逆数が多項式で抑えられる限り多項式スケーリングを保ち、大規模ボソンサンプリング実験における光子の不可識別性検証に特に適することを示す。

title: Multiplicative Noise in Nanolaser Amplification: From Discrete Emission Events to the Additive-Noise Limit
abstract: Laser amplification kicks off with just a few photons in the cavity, a regime where standard additive Langevin noise cannot capture the real fluctuations. To understand how this amplification begins, we map out a single-mode photon-carrier model that links macroscopic lasers directly into nanolasers. Stationary rate equations reveal that stimulated emission takes over across a tight pump window. In nanolasers, however, spontaneous processes coexist across a much broader range. Because steady-state averages miss the individual events that lead to the macroscopic photon number, we frame the stochastic dynamics around the actual discrete transitions, deriving a state-dependent diffusion approximation. The destruction of an excited carrier concurrent with the generation of a photon creates a negative photon-carrier cross-correlation. This unavoidably leads to a correlated, multiplicative Gaussian-noise framework. We track the resulting discrete dynamics with an established, event-based Laser Markov Chain (LMC) which stochastically samples pump, relaxation, emission, and cavity-loss events keeping all physical quantities as non-negative integers. Comparing its predictions to those of our multiplicative model proves that the latter reproduces excellently well the statistical behavior of photons and carrier, as long as a continuous diffusion description holds. Once the emission drops into the few-photon regime, however, the discrete model becomes indispensable. On the other hand, at large photon counts relative fluctuations shrink to a level where the state-dependence of the diffusion matrix can be ignored, to leading order, thus returning to the classic Langevin description of the system's stochastic dynamics.

summaries.en: By deriving a state-dependent multiplicative Gaussian-noise model from discrete photon-carrier transitions and benchmarking it against an event-based Laser Markov Chain, the authors show that this diffusion description accurately reproduces nanolaser statistics until few-photon emission requires fully discrete treatment, while at large photon counts it reduces to the classic additive Langevin limit.
summaries.zh: 作者从离散的光子-载流子跃迁出发推导出一个依赖状态的乘性高斯噪声模型，并与基于事件的激光马尔可夫链进行对比，证明该扩散描述能准确再现纳米激光器的统计行为，直到少光子发射情形必须采用完全离散的处理，而在大光子数下则回归经典的加性朗之万极限。
summaries.ja: 著者らは離散的な光子-キャリア遷移から状態依存の乗算的ガウスノイズモデルを導出し、イベントベースのレーザーマルコフ連鎖と比較することで、この拡散記述が少数光子発光で完全離散的な扱いが必要となるまでナノレーザーの統計的振る舞いを正確に再現し、大きな光子数では古典的な加算的ランジュバン極限に帰着することを示した。

title: A Dual-Uplink Dual-Satellite Architecture for Entanglement Distribution
abstract: Satellite-based quantum links are a promising enabler of long-distance entanglement distribution, overcoming the exponential losses of optical fibers. In uplink architectures, entangled photons are generated at ground stations and transmitted to orbiting satellites, reducing space-segment complexity but introducing significant atmospheric and geometric losses. Single-satellite dual-uplink configurations are additionally limited by the requirement of simultaneous visibility between both ground stations and the satellite. In this work, we investigate a dual-uplink dual-satellite network architecture and compare its performance with the single-satellite scheme under identical physical assumptions. The proposed topology introduces an inter-satellite link (ISL) that decouples the ground-station separation from the atmospheric uplink geometry. A realistic channel model is employed, incorporating geometric attenuation, atmospheric turbulence, background noise, and Bell-state measurement efficiency. The overall success probability and practical fidelity are evaluated as functions of satellite altitude and ground-station separation. Our results show that while the single-satellite configuration is suitable for regional-scale networks, it becomes infeasible for large separations due to geometric constraints. The proposed dual-satellite architecture mitigates this limitation and significantly extends the achievable communication distance, representing a key step toward scalable quantum internet infrastructures.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Networking and Internet Architecture (cs.NI)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a dual-uplink dual-satellite architecture with an inter-satellite link that decouples ground-station separation from atmospheric uplink geometry, and shows via a realistic channel model incorporating geometric attenuation, turbulence, background noise, and Bell-state measurement efficiency that it significantly extends achievable entanglement-distribution distance compared with the single-satellite scheme, which is limited to regional scales.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种带星间链路的双上行双卫星架构，使地面站间距与大气上行几何解耦，并借助包含几何衰减、大气湍流、背景噪声和贝尔态测量效率的真实信道模型表明，相比仅适用于区域尺度的单卫星方案，该架构显著扩展了可实现的纠缠分发距离。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、地上局間距離を大気アップリンクの幾何条件から切り離す衛星間リンクを備えたデュアルアップリンク・デュアル衛星アーキテクチャを提案し、幾何減衰・大気揺らぎ・背景雑音・ベル状態測定効率を含む現実的なチャネルモデルにより、地域規模に限定される単一衛星方式と比べてエンタングルメント配布の到達距離を大幅に拡張できることを示した。

title: Sidewall Metrology Protocol for Superconducting Qubit Devices
abstract: Sidewall morphology is a potentially important factor influencing superconducting qubit performance, yet its quantitative characterization remains challenging due to the absence of standardized measurement protocols. In this work, we develop a scanning probe microscopy-based measurement framework for the quantitative characterization of superconducting qubit sidewalls. The framework introduces a refined root mean square lateral sidewall roughness descriptor and a new curvature-equivalent radius for quantifying vertical sidewall morphology. The descriptors and measurement procedures are applied to different components of qubit devices, forming the basis of a proposed sidewall characterization protocol. This provides a foundation for quantitative comparisons of fabrication processes across laboratories, enabling future investigations of correlations between sidewall geometry and qubit performance.

summaries.en: This work develops a scanning probe microscopy-based measurement framework with a refined root mean square lateral sidewall roughness descriptor and a new curvature-equivalent radius to quantitatively characterize superconducting qubit sidewalls and enable cross-laboratory comparisons of fabrication processes.
summaries.zh: 本研究开发了一套基于扫描探针显微镜的测量框架，提出改进的侧壁横向均方根粗糙度描述符和新的曲率等效半径以定量表征超导量子比特侧壁，从而为不同实验室间制备工艺的定量比较奠定基础。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、改良された側壁横方向二乗平均平方根粗さ記述子と新たな曲率等価半径を備えた走査型プローブ顕微鏡ベースの測定枠組みを開発し、超伝導量子ビット側壁を定量的に特性評価して実験室間での作製プロセスの定量的比較を可能にする。

title: Giant Rydberg Excitons Delineated as Relativistic Bound States
abstract: We examined the energy-momentum relationship of the valence band of Cu$_2$O, which has gained interest as an emerging solid host for giant Rydberg states. Our findings reveal a nonparabolic dispersion, described using the rest mass (0.570 times the free electron mass) and rescaled light speed ($1.6\times 10^5$ m/s), which draws parallels with relativistic theory for high-energy particles. We propose a straightforward expression for the bound-state energies of Rydberg excitons with finite quantum defects, whose energy scheme deviates from the hydrogenic series. This formulation identifies relativistic kinematics as the physical origin of quantum defects, offering a streamlined basis for future studies on complex many-body correlations.

summaries.en: The valence band of Cu2O exhibits a nonparabolic dispersion describable with an effective rest mass and rescaled light speed, and this relativistic kinematics is identified as the physical origin of the quantum defects that shift Rydberg exciton bound-state energies away from the hydrogenic series.
summaries.zh: Cu2O的价带表现出非抛物色散，可用有效静止质量和重标度光速描述，而这种相对论性运动学被认定为量子缺陷的物理起源，使里德伯激子束缚态能级偏离氢原子序列。
summaries.ja: Cu2Oの価電子帯は有効静止質量と再スケールされた光速で記述できる非放物線的分散を示し、この相対論的運動学が、リュードベリ励起子の束縛状態エネルギーを水素型系列からずらす量子欠損の物理的起源であると同定された。

title: End-to-End Optimization of Partial Fault Tolerance in Neutral-Atom Arrays
abstract: Fault-tolerant (FT) quantum computation offers a pathway to quantum advantage, but its realization is hindered by its significant overhead. The partially FT "STAR" architecture reduces the cost of universal computation at the price of relaxing FT requirements for non-Clifford operations, increasing exposure to hardware noise. Therefore, maximizing its performance and applicability demands careful co-design with the underlying hardware. In this work we investigate the co-design of the STAR architecture with neutral-atom platforms, connecting the underlying atomic physics to logical error modeling and application-level performance. At the physical level, we identify a favorable noise bias in $^{171}\mathrm{Yb}$ Rydberg gates, and show how it can be enhanced through error-selective pulse optimization. At the logical level, we identify an intrinsic error suppression mechanism, yielding vanishing logical coherent noise in leading order. Detailed circuit-level simulations of surface code implementations show more than an order of magnitude reduction in logical error relative to previous estimates. As a concrete target application, we focus on the Fermi-Hubbard model with periodic boundaries, for which we design a simulation circuit particularly suited to early implementations. We quantify the resource tradeoff of partially and fully FT approaches to gate synthesis, with the former showing approximately an order of magnitude reduction in state-injection depth, and an even larger reduction in Clifford resources. Comparing with classical and fully FT approaches, we identify regimes where partial fault tolerance provides both lower overheads and lower error rates. In our estimates, this is accessible with moderate error rates $p\sim 10^{-3}$ and a few thousand qubits, underlining that for these types of problems, partial FT approaches provide a compelling pathway to early quantum advantage.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: This work co-designs the partially fault-tolerant STAR architecture with neutral-atom platforms, leveraging a favorable noise bias in 171Yb Rydberg gates and an intrinsic coherent-error suppression to show over an order-of-magnitude lower logical error in surface codes and roughly an order-of-magnitude reduction in state-injection depth, identifying regimes where partial fault tolerance offers lower overheads and error rates than fully fault-tolerant approaches at moderate error rates p ~ 10^-3 with a few thousand qubits for applications such as the periodic-boundary Fermi-Hubbard model.
summaries.zh: 本工作将部分容错的STAR架构与中性原子平台进行协同设计，利用171Yb里德堡门中有利的噪声偏置以及内禀的相干误差抑制机制，在表面码中实现比先前估计低一个数量级以上的逻辑错误率，并将态注入深度降低约一个数量级，从而在中等错误率p~10^-3、数千量子比特的条件下，针对周期性边界费米-哈伯德模型等问题确定了部分容错方案比完全容错方案具有更低开销和更低错误率的适用区域。
summaries.ja: 本研究は部分的なフォールトトレラントSTARアーキテクチャを中性原子プラットフォームと協調設計し、171Ybリドベリゲートにおける有利なノイズバイアスと内在的なコヒーレント誤り抑制により、表面符号で従来推定より一桁以上低い論理誤り率と約一桁低い状態注入深さを実現し、周期境界フェルミ・ハバード模型などの応用において、誤り率p~10^-3・数千量子ビット規模で部分的フォールトトレラント手法が完全フォールトトレラント手法より低いオーバーヘッドと誤り率を提供する領域を特定した。

title: Beyond Fidelity: Resolving Errors in Photonic Seed State Generation
abstract: An important aspect of many linear optical quantum computing architectures is probabilistically generating small dual-rail qubit entangled states, or seed states. While many schemes to achieve this have been discovered, attention has been primarily focused on minimizing input resources and maximizing success probability rather than establishing a detailed understanding of linear-optical error performance. In this work, we develop a framework for resolving sensitivities to physically distinct errors in linear optical state generation, allowing us to identify precise ways in which these errors affect the properties of the output state. We use this framework to identify seed state generators in which destructive many-photon interference prevents detector loss and detector noise from causing a falsely successful heralding event. We show that this effect suppresses errors, for example cutting the effective loss on the output of particular Bell state generators in half relative to a standard scheme. We also present a new Bell state generator in which both detector loss and detector noise do not affect the quality of the output Bell state to first order, and a 4GHZ generator with >75% higher success probability than a standard circuit. In addition we provide some useful identities, bounds and invariants for studying linear optical seed state generation.

summaries.en: The paper develops a framework for resolving sensitivities to physically distinct errors in linear optical seed-state generation, identifying schemes where destructive many-photon interference suppresses detector loss and noise effects—halving effective output loss in some Bell state generators and yielding a Bell state generator robust to both to first order, plus a 4GHZ generator with over 75% higher success probability than a standard circuit.
summaries.zh: 该论文建立了一个框架，用于解析线性光学种子态产生中对物理上不同误差的敏感性，识别出破坏性多光子干涉可抑制探测器损耗与噪声影响的方案——使某些贝尔态产生器的有效输出损耗减半，并给出对两者一阶不敏感的贝尔态产生器，以及成功率比标准电路高75%以上的4GHZ产生器。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、線形光学によるシード状態生成において物理的に異なる誤差への感度を解析する枠組みを開発し、破壊的多光子干渉が検出器損失と検出器雑音の影響を抑制する方式を特定して、一部のベル状態生成器で実効出力損失を半減させ、両方に一次で影響されないベル状態生成器や標準回路より75%以上高い成功確率を持つ4GHZ生成器を示した。

title: Curved HF Monopole Antennas for Improved Low-Angle Skywave Gain Over Lossy Ground
abstract: High-frequency (HF) skywave radars require high gain at elevation angles of 3 degrees to 30 degrees, where vertically-polarized monopoles over lossy land suffer from pseudo-Brewster cancellation. This letter shows that curving a long monopole creates a horizontally-polarized radiation channel much less affected by this cancellation. Closed-form bounds derived from the space-wave field over a homogeneous half-space show that the vertical-current field is suppressed below an elevation set by the soil permittivity, whereas the horizontally-polarized field of an elevated arc is nearly unaffected by the soil. Bayesian optimization (BO) of an analytical model, followed by 182 full-wave HFSS simulations with analytical Fresnel far-field post-processing, was used to design the element at 15 MHz. Over moist soil, a 15-m element with an 86 degrees arc is near-resonant (-25-dB match), 93% efficient, and 25% lower than a straight element of equal length. It raises the azimuth-averaged 3 degrees-30 degrees gain by 2.5 dB and, on every land ground considered, exceeds the 0.575{\lambda} straight monopole that is optimal over seawater and PEC by 1.0-2.6 dB.

summaries.en: Curving a long HF monopole creates a horizontally polarized radiation channel that avoids pseudo-Brewster cancellation over lossy ground, raising azimuth-averaged 3°–30° skywave gain by 2.
summaries.zh: 将长高频单极子弯曲可产生一个水平极化辐射通道，从而规避有耗地面上的伪布儒斯特抵消，使3°至30°方位平均天波增益相对直单极子提高2.
summaries.ja: 長いHFモノポールを湾曲させることで、損失性地面上での擬似ブルースター抵消の影響を受けにくい水平偏波放射チャネルが形成され、直線素子に比べて3°〜30°の方位平均スカイウェーブ利得が2.

title: Performance Analysis of Discrete-Activation Pinching-Antenna Systems
abstract: This paper investigates discrete-activation pinching antenna (DAPA) systems, where a finite set of pinching antennas (PAs) is deployed along a dielectric waveguide, from which PAs are selectively activated to serve users. Performance analyses are developed for both orthogonal multiple access (OMA) and non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) by explicitly accounting for the system geometry and discrete PA activation. Specifically, analytical expressions for the outage probability (OP) and ergodic rate (ER) are derived. Furthermore, the discrete-to-continuous gain ratio (DCGR) is introduced to quantify the normalized ER gain of a finite PA deployment relative to the single-PA and continuous-activation references. Monte Carlo simulations validate the derived expressions and show that DAPA systems can closely approach continuous-activation performance with only a moderate number of candidate PAs. For example, under the considered setup, DAPA with five PAs recovers approximately 92% and 90% of the continuous-activation ER gain under OMA and NOMA, respectively, at a transmit power of 0 dBm.

summaries.en: This paper analytically derives outage probability and ergodic rate for discrete-activation pinching-antenna systems under OMA and NOMA, introducing a discrete-to-continuous gain ratio that shows a moderate number of candidate antennas, such as five recovering about 92% and 90% of continuous-activation ergodic-rate gain at 0 dBm.
summaries.zh: 本文针对正交多址和非正交多址下的离散激活夹持天线系统推导了中断概率和遍历速率的解析表达式，并引入离散到连续增益比，表明仅需适量候选天线（如五个天线在0 dBm下分别恢复约92%和90%的连续激活遍历速率增益）即可接近连续激活性能。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、直交多元接続と非直交多元接続の下で離散活性化ピンチングアンテナシステムの停止確率とエルゴディックレートの解析式を導出し、離散対連続利得比を導入して、適度な数の候補アンテナ（例えば5本で0 dBm時に連続活性化のエルゴディックレート利得の約92%と90%を回復）で連続活性化性能に近づけることを示した。

title: Three Machines Suffice for Local Hardening of Electromechanical Oscillations
abstract: The single-degree-of-freedom swing equation with sinusoidal coupling is locally softening: its oscillation frequency decreases with oscillation level near a stable equilibrium. Nonlinear modal interaction, however, can reverse this trend in multimachine systems. This letter gives a necessary-and-sufficient condition for strict leading-order local hardening, measured with respect to canonical action, in two symmetric three-machine operating-point families with equal or opposite power injections at the equal-inertia machines. An exact two-coordinate reduction expresses the condition in terms of a squared modal-frequency ratio and a dimensionless nonlinear coupling measure. The proof retains the induced mean shift and second harmonic and shows that the companion modal family remains locally softening. The criterion recovers both an equal-inertia hardening example and an exact large-inertia threshold. Coherent aggregation recovers the two-machine softening law, whereas the infinite-bus limit retains two dynamic rotor angles and permits hardening. An exact coherent-group extension preserves the selected periodic family, frequency, and canonical action for every finite machine count greater than two. Thus, three finite-inertia machines are the minimum permitting local hardening in the stated undamped, lossless classical model.

summaries.en: This letter establishes a necessary-and-sufficient condition for strict leading-order local hardening, measured with respect to canonical action, in two symmetric three-machine operating-point families with equal or opposite power injections at equal-inertia machines, proving that three finite-inertia machines are the minimum permitting local hardening in the undamped, lossless classical model.
summaries.zh: 本文针对等惯量机组间注入功率相等或相反的两类对称三机运行点族，给出了以正则作用量度量的严格领头阶局部硬化之充要条件，并证明在所述无阻尼、无损经典模型中，三台有限惯量机组是实现局部硬化的最小数目。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、等慣性機の注入電力が等しいか逆である2つの対称な三機運転点ファミリーにおいて、正準作用量に関して測った厳密な先頭次数の局所硬化に対する必要十分条件を与え、無減衰・無損失の古典モデルにおいて局所硬化を可能にする最小の有限慣性機数が3台であることを示した。

title: Optical ISAC with Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) Arrays
abstract: Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) arrays offer photon-level sensitivity for sensing in optical integrated sensing and communication (O-ISAC). However, after each detection, a SPAD is blind for a dead time, which saturates the array at high received power. Existing O-ISAC analyses assume linear receivers and do not capture this effect. In this paper, we study ranging with a SPAD array in a monostatic O-ISAC system based on direct-current-biased optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (DCO-OFDM). Sampling the array once per dead time, we model the number of pixels that detect a photon in each sampling interval as a binomial random variable whose success probability accounts for the intensity variation of the echo within a dead time. Based on this model, we derive the Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) for range estimation. We show that the SPAD count model of optical wireless communication, which assumes a constant photon rate over a dead time, causes a range bias that depends on the received power. Moreover, unlike for a linear photodiode, saturation degrades the ranging accuracy beyond a sensing-optimal transmit power. The rate-constrained operating point is then the larger of this power and the power needed for the target data rate. Numerical results validate the analysis against a continuous-time photon-counting simulation and show that the proposed model is needed for ranging.

summaries.en: This paper models SPAD-array photon counts as binomial random variables that account for intra-dead-time echo intensity variation to derive the Cramér-Rao bound for ranging in a monostatic DCO-OFDM optical ISAC system, showing that constant-rate count models cause a power-dependent range bias and that saturation degrades ranging accuracy beyond a sensing-optimal transmit power.
summaries.zh: 本文将SPAD阵列的光子计数建模为二项随机变量，该变量考虑了死区时间内回波强度的变化，据此推导了基于DCO-OFDM的单站光通感一体化系统中测距的克拉美-罗界，并表明假设死区时间内光子速率恒定的计数模型会导致与接收功率相关的测距偏差，且饱和会使测距精度在超过感知最优发射功率后下降。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、SPADアレイの光子計数をデッドタイム内のエコー強度変動を考慮した二項確率変数としてモデル化し、DCO-OFDMを用いたモノスタティック光ISACシステムにおける測距のクラーメル・ラオ下限を導出するとともに、デッドタイム中の光子レートを一定と仮定する計数モデルが受信電力に依存する測距バイアスを生じさせ、飽和が感知最適送信電力を超えると測距精度を劣化させることを示す。

title: Waveguide Deployment Optimization for Pinching-Antenna Systems
abstract: Most existing studies on pinching-antenna systems optimize the antenna positions or activation states under a prescribed waveguide deployment, where mutually parallel waveguides are commonly adopted. However, it remains unclear whether, and under what conditions, such a deployment is optimal from a communication-performance perspective. To fill this gap, this paper investigates long-term waveguide deployment optimization for pinching-antenna systems over a rectangular service region. We first consider the fundamental two-waveguide case and derive a closed-form sufficient condition, jointly determined by the waveguide height and the service-region aspect ratio, under which a deployment parallel to the longer side of the service region is globally optimal. We then consider the general multi-waveguide case, where the orientation and offset of each waveguide are jointly optimized without prescribing any deployment pattern, and develop an adaptive exchange algorithm for the resulting nonconvex optimization problem. We further show that, within the parallel class, the waveguides should be aligned with the longer side of the service region, while in the large-height regime, the globally optimal unrestricted deployment asymptotically concentrates all waveguides on the centerline along the longer side. Numerical results validate the proposed algorithm and reveal how the preferred deployment geometry depends on the waveguide height and service-region shape. In particular, nonparallel deployments can provide noticeable gains in intermediate-height regimes, whereas parallel or center-concentrated deployments become favorable in other regimes.

summaries.en: This paper investigates long-term waveguide deployment optimization for pinching-antenna systems over a rectangular service region, deriving a closed-form condition under which a deployment parallel to the longer side is globally optimal for two waveguides and developing an adaptive exchange algorithm for the general nonconvex multi-waveguide case, showing that nonparallel deployments can yield gains in intermediate-height regimes.
summaries.zh: 本文研究矩形服务区域内夹持天线系统的长期波导部署优化问题，针对双波导情形推导了由波导高度和服务区域长宽比共同决定、使平行于较长边的部署全局最优的闭式充分条件，并针对一般的非凸多波导情形提出了自适应交换算法，结果表明非平行部署在中等高度区间可带来明显增益。
summaries.ja: 本論文は矩形サービス領域におけるピンチングアンテナシステムの長期的な導波路配置最適化を研究し、2導波路の場合に導波路高さとサービス領域のアスペクト比で決まる、長辺に平行な配置が大域最適となる閉形式の十分条件を導出するとともに、一般の非凸な多導波路問題に対して適応交換アルゴリズムを開発し、中間的な高さ領域では非平行配置が顕著な利得をもたらすことを示した。
